You are completing a web task using a browser automation server.

GOAL: Click on the "No" button.

The automation server listens on http://127.0.0.1:8766. Drive it over HTTP with curl:

  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8766/command -d '{"op":"find","css":"body"}'   # inspect
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8766/command -d '{"op":"click","text":"Login"}'
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8766/commands -d '[{"op":"input","css":"#user","value":"x"},{"op":"click","text":"Submit"}]'

Ops include: goto, back, reload, find, get_text, click, input, select, press,
scroll, tab_new, tab_list, tab_switch. Every mutating op returns a dom_diff
describing what changed -- read it instead of re-fetching the page. A find
that matches nothing means the thing is not on the page; do not retry
blindly. GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/ops lists all ops.

Accomplish the GOAL on the page that is already open, then STOP and reply
with just: DONE
